items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling: Progressing in recovery
items.text:
Stribling (ankle) was spotted Monday walking without crutches or a brace on his lower leg, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Loses starting gig, now No. 3 QB
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said that Brissett will be removed from the starting role and serve as the Cardinals' No. 3 quarterback in Sunday's game in Seattle, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Kendrick Bourne: Could face season-ending ankle injury
items.text:
Coach Mike LaFleur noted Monday that the ankle injury Bourne suffered Sunday against the Cowboys could be season-ending,  Darren Urban of Cardschatter reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Bam Knight: Enters concussion protocol
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur revealed Monday that Knight is in the concussion protocol following Sunday's overtime win in Dallas, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Dealing with 'new' ankle injury
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Monday that Love suffered a "new" ankle injury during Sunday's overtime win at Dallas, and that he'll have an update on the running back later this week, Josh Weinfuss of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
